description: Charcoal Grilled Tandoori Chicken is a classic Indian dish known for its vibrant red color, smoky aroma, and tender, juicy meat. Marinated in a rich blend of yogurt and spices, then cooked over hot coals, it offers an unparalleled depth of flavor. This recipe brings the authentic taste of a traditional tandoor to your backyard grill, perfect for a memorable dinner.

instructions.title: Prepare the Chicken
instructions.text: Wash the chicken pieces thoroughly and pat them completely dry with paper towels. Make 2-3 deep slits on each piece to allow the marinade to penetrate deeply.

instructions.title: First Marinade
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the chicken with lemon juice, 1 tablespoon ginger-garlic paste, 1 tablespoon Kashmiri red chili powder, and 1 teaspoon salt. Mix well to coat all pieces evenly. Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes at room temperature, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.

instructions.title: Second Marinade
instructions.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the yogurt, remaining ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri red chili powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, black pepper, and red food color (if using). Stir in the mustard oil. Add the chicken from the first marinade to this yogurt mixture, ensuring each piece is fully coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, for best flavor.

instructions.title: Prepare the Charcoal Grill
instructions.text: About 30 minutes before grilling, prepare your charcoal grill. Arrange the hot coals on one side of the grill for indirect heat, leaving the other side empty. Ensure the coals are glowing red with a thin layer of ash.

instructions.title: Grill the Chicken
instructions.text: Place the marinated chicken pieces directly over the hot coals. Sear for 2-3 minutes per side until lightly charred. Then, move the chicken to the cooler side of the grill (indirect heat), close the lid, and cook for 20-25 minutes, flipping occasionally. The internal temperature should reach 165F (74C).

instructions.title: Baste and Finish
instructions.text: During the last 5-7 minutes of cooking, baste the chicken generously with melted butter or ghee. Move the chicken back over direct heat for a final char and smoky finish, turning frequently to prevent burning. Cook until beautifully charred and cooked through.

instructions.title: Serve Hot
instructions.text: Remove the Tandoori Chicken from the grill. Garnish with fresh chopped cilantro and serve immediately with lemon wedges, mint chutney, and onion rings. Enjoy the authentic smoky flavors!

tips: For truly authentic flavor, ensure your yogurt is thick and drained of excess whey. This helps the marinade cling better to the chicken.
Do not skip the deep cuts in the chicken; they are crucial for the marinade to penetrate and flavor the meat from within.
For the best smoky flavor, add a few wood chips (like apple or cherry) to your charcoal at the beginning of the grilling process.
article:
Craving the smoky, spicy, and tender flavors of authentic Indian cuisine? Tandoori Chicken, especially when charcoal grilled, is your answer. This iconic Indian dinner recipe brings restaurant-quality taste right to your backyard. Master the art of making delicious **Charcoal Grilled Tandoori Chicken** with these simple steps and impress everyone!

## What is Charcoal Grilled Tandoori Chicken?
Tandoori Chicken is a classic South Asian dish, traditionally cooked in a tandoor, a clay oven imparting a unique smoky char and keeping meat moist. It's marinated in yogurt and vibrant spices like ginger, garlic, red chili, turmeric, cumin, coriander, and garam masala, giving it its characteristic reddish-orange hue and complex flavor.

A charcoal grill offers a fantastic home alternative to a tandoor, closely mimicking its intense heat and smoky essence. Grilling over charcoal infuses the chicken with an unmistakable aroma and a beautifully charred exterior, while the yogurt tenderizes from within. The result is succulent, flavorful, and smoky chicken – a perfect Indian dinner. Making **Charcoal Grilled Tandoori Chicken** at home is a truly rewarding culinary experience.

## Ingredients You Need
To embark on your Tandoori Chicken adventure, gather these fresh ingredients:

For the Chicken:
*   2 lbs (about 900g) bone-in, skin-on chicken pieces (thighs/drumsticks recommended)
*   Juice of 1 lemon

*   1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
